edition.title: English Translation - Rowwad Translation Center
edition.description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

rows.translation: When the earth is shaken with a mighty quake,
and the earth throws out its burdens[1],
rows.footnotes: [1] i.e., its dead bodies and treasures.

rows.translation: and man says[2], “What is the matter with it?”
On that Day it will recount all its news,
because your Lord has inspired it [to do so].
On that Day all people will come forward in separate groups to be shown their deeds[3].
rows.footnotes: [3] From the place of Judgment to see the consequences of their deeds, whether to Paradise or to Hell.

rows.translation: So whoever does an atom’s weight[4] of good will see it,
and whoever does an atom’s weight of evil will see it.
